question: How should Cairn separate account bindings, worker slots and live agent identity to route messages by current harness and project, and sequence the deferred coordination features?
scope: live identity and metadata routing requirements

authority_boundary.authority_source: Owner requested fungible UUID/ordinal identities, metadata-based targeting and a plan for deferred v1 work; existing design decisions were delegated.
authorized_scope: record the design and implementation plan
correct account coverage using existing wakeup deployment procedures

evidence.summary: Two Codex and two Claude accounts; agent names must be fungible; resolve the Codex agent working on Rhumb using metadata; plan deferred v1 work.

provenance.method: Selected requirements from the current owner instructions

evidence.summary: PostgreSQL operational state, authenticated inbox ownership, exact references, explicit completion and durable process holds remain the installed contract.

assertions.text: The owner requires identity independent of accounts/harnesses and targeting from current work context.
The existing messaging and wakeup contracts constrain new identity/routing behavior.
Sequence authenticated instances, presence, resolution and session delivery before scheduling and broader coordination controls. Keep worker-slot coverage distinct from live-agent identity.
assertions.owner: repository owner via delegated design task

alternatives.option: Live UUID identity plus fresh metadata and authenticated routing
Harness/account names or static slots alone identify live agents
Replace PostgreSQL polling with a broker before resolving identity

verification_criteria: Per-milestone acceptance criteria and preservation checks in the plan
Disposable database integration/static/restore checks for store changes
Real Rhumb-targeting session trial before claiming live routing
reopening_conditions: Native resume/fork semantics contradict the proposed identity continuity
Supported session delivery requires a different adapter contract
Measured latency or availability requires revisiting the transport
residual_risk: Instance-credential issuance and adapter lifecycle contracts still require implementation and tests
Directory routing and existing-session delivery are planned, not deployed
Provider usage limits and future account failures remain independent of service liveness
